correctness.rationale: Identity f(x)+1=x²−1 yields one-step growth of odd valuation to −1. Identities f(x)−2=(x−2)(x+2) and f(x)+2=x² yield exact two-step valuation growth in each even subbranch. Four dyadic roots of x²=1 and exact m(m+1) congruence counts give all histogram coefficients; boundary moduli checked separately. Actual standalone checker enumerated every input mod 2^k for k=1..17 and agreed with all pointwise and histogram statements. Infinite proof is arithmetic, not enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural monic Dickson polynomial has a fully classified functional graph for all powers of two, with sharp quantitative depth statistics in two basins. Unlike a routine point sample or mere fixed-point computation, the theorem identifies two valuation-growth mechanisms and closes the complete inverse-preperiod census uniformly in k.
